description: This Java class defines an immutable data object for role data within the Fineract project, encapsulating role properties and providing methods to convert to related permission data.

classes.name: RoleData
classes.description: Immutable data object representing a role with properties such as id, name, description, and disabled status.

methods.name: toRolePermissionData
methods.description: Converts RoleData to a RolePermissionsData object, incorporating permission usage data.

methods.name: RoleData
methods.description: Constructor to initialize RoleData with id, name, description, and disabled status.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare RoleData objects based on their id.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode to generate hash based on id.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Getter for the role's unique identifier.
